steps.instruction: Mix 3/4 cup of coconut flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder and a pinch of salt.
steps.spoken: In a big bowl, mix 3/4 cup of coconut flour, 1 teaspoon of baking powder and a pinch of salt.

steps.instruction: Stir in up to 1/2 teaspoon of xanthan gum, if you like.
steps.spoken: If you like, stir in 1/2 teaspoon or less of xanthan gum.

steps.instruction: Add 6 whole medium eggs and 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
Mix well with a spoon until the batter gets thick.
steps.spoken: Mix well with a spoon until the batter gets thick. You can add extra coconut flour if it feels too liquid.

steps.instruction: Pour the dough evenly into a loaf pan lined with parchment paper.
steps.spoken: Pour the dough evenly into a loaf pan. Line the pan with parchment paper, or coat it with butter.

steps.instruction: Take the bread out of the oven and let it cool.
